title: No Leather Armour Recipes
description: Simply removes the vanilla crafting recipes for all leather armour items, including horse armour. Intended to be used alongside mods which add alternate crafting methods.
body:
Simply removes vanilla crafting recipes for leather armour, including leather horse armour.
Intended to be used alongside mods which add alternate crafting methods. ![No Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/BNNufJaG/images/b46d53f96ccaed02e0d735c3e7274ef89acfcf5b.png)
